coupling.rationale: Components expose narrow prop interfaces and server/client code are cleanly separated per page, but the shared TypeBadge is bypassed in three places, the sortable-table contract ties markup to an inline script, and the resource-fetching seam is split between data.ts and direct getJson calls.

evidence: app/src/lib/data.ts:18-20 — SpeciesRef/HomeEntry are real data shapes that all four card lists reuse without re-shaping
app/src/pages/moves/[name].astro:19-29 — detail-page 404 boilerplate duplicated verbatim in pokemon, abilities, types; an Items section would copy it again
app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:268-335 — the isLevelUp boolean triples the colgroup/th/td markup instead of a column-driven table
app/src/lib/data.ts:23-30 — memoize-then-reset-on-error pattern hand-rolled seven times instead of a memoize() helper
app/src/components/PokemonCard.astro:6-7 — optional `types`/`hidden` flags stretch to all four lists acceptably
abstraction_design.rationale: The data layer and card component stretch to new cases without copying, but page-level scaffolding (404 handling, detail layout, card lists) has no shared abstraction, so a new resource type means copying a Moves page, and the moves table leans on a boolean flag rather than column variation.

findings.issue: The '<count> Pokémon' + <ul class=card-grid> block is duplicated in four pages (moves, abilities, types, index), so any change to card lists (sorting, empty state, markup) must be made four times.
findings.suggestion: Extract a PokemonCardList.astro component (props: list, showTypes) and render it from all four pages.

findings.issue: The alternate-form exclusion rule (id > 10000 / <= 10000) is re-implemented in four places (types:53, moves:53, abilities:40, data.ts:168), so changing the rule means four edits.
findings.suggestion: Add a single helper in lib (e.g. defaultSpeciesRefsFrom(entries) returning species refs via getSpeciesIndex) and use it from all call sites.

findings.issue: Seven hand-rolled memoized promise singletons, each with its own copy of the catch-and-reset boilerplate; a caching-rule change (TTL, invalidation) touches eight places including getJson's cache in pokeapi.ts:28.
findings.suggestion: Extract a memoize(key, factory) helper in lib and drive all seven caches through it, so cache policy lives in one spot.

findings.issue: The try/getJson/NotFoundError/Astro.response.status=404 pattern is copy-pasted in four detail pages; the next resource type (e.g. Items) copies it a fifth time.
findings.suggestion: Extract a loadOrNotFound(path) helper (or a shared DetailPage wrapper component) that renders the NotFound component and sets the status.

findings.issue: The moves table couples colgroup widths, th data-sort-key headers, td cells, per-row data-* attributes and the inline script's numericKeys set; adding or removing a column requires synchronized edits in five spots, and the isLevelUp flag triples the markup.
findings.suggestion: Describe columns as a config array (key, label, numeric, width) and render colgroup/th/td from it, deriving data-* attributes from the same array; consider extracting the moves-table data prep from frontmatter into lib.

findings.issue: TypeBadge exists but the type-badge anchor markup is inlined in the pokemon summary (229-233), the move table (:332) and the types page (:78), duplicating the badge contract.
findings.suggestion: Use the TypeBadge component everywhere the badge is rendered, or delete it and keep the class as the single contract.

findings.issue: Filter query-string serialization is written twice: pageHref on the server (:37-45) and navigate() on the client (:110-119); changing which params are emitted/omitted needs both.
findings.suggestion: Share one buildFilterURL(params, page) helper (imported into the client script via a module) so the URL contract is defined once.

findings.issue: English type-label resolution is done three different ways: one-off getTypeDetail call (moves:44), a typeEnglishByName map built from getTypeDetail (pokemon:110-113), and a getTypes() map (types:33-34).
findings.suggestion: Add a typeLabels() helper in lib/data.ts (built from the already-cached getTypes) and use it in all three places.

findings.issue: The `hidden` prop and .card-note style (global.css:344) exist solely for the ability page and become dead code if Abilities is removed.
findings.suggestion: Rename to something ability-specific (e.g. note) or accept an optional footer slot so the card stays generic.

findings.issue: Astro's base tsconfig is strict by default; overriding to strict:false plus pervasive `any` in the data plumbing removes the safety net for exactly the kind of edits this app invites.
findings.suggestion: Re-enable strict and type the API shapes at the lib boundary (PokeSpecies, PokeMove, etc.) so pages get checked shapes.

summary: A tidy, current-stack Astro app with genuinely good seams at the component and data-helper level: sprites, cards and the home index each live in one place, and removing Abilities is almost free. But cross-cutting rules (alternate-form filtering, card lists, 404 handling, memoization, type labels) are duplicated across the four detail pages, so anything not covered by an existing component is an N-place fix. Net: pleasant small edits, mediocre medium ones — the next resource type (Items) would be a copy-paste of Moves.

scenarios.change: Remove the Abilities pages and every link to them

Optional cleanup: the ability-only `hidden` prop on PokemonCard and .card-note CSS. All other styles are shared.

scenarios.change: Fix the card sprite for species whose default Pokémon has a different name (e.g. Deoxys)
scenarios.notes: The sprite URL is built in exactly one place (PokemonCard.astro:10 via spriteUrl in pokeapi.ts:44), and all four lists (index, moves, abilities, types) render through PokemonCard, so one fix covers every list. If the fix needs the default variety's own ID rather than the species ID, SpeciesRef (built in data.ts:96-108 from the species list endpoint) must be extended — still a contained change, but two files instead of one.

scenarios.change: Add sorting by name to every list of Pokémon cards
scenarios.notes: There is no shared card-list abstraction: each of the four pages builds and sorts its own array and renders its own <ul class=card-grid> + count markup. Sorting must be added in four places, and on the home page it interacts with the 48-per-page pagination and the client-side innerHTML swap. Extracting a PokemonCardList component first would turn this into a one-file change.

scenarios.change: Add an Items section (/items, /items/:name) shaped like Moves
scenarios.notes: Roughly half is reusable as-is: BaseLayout, NotFound, the lib/pokeapi helpers (getJson, englishName, formatMissing), the .detail-list/.section CSS and the 404/500 behavior pattern. But the detail-page scaffolding — 404 try/catch, English-name resolution, the dl panel and Effect section — exists only as copy-paste inside moves/[name].astro, so the new page is largely a duplicate of it; nav would also need a new link in BaseLayout (currently only Pokémon/Types).

scenarios.change: Change the API base URL and caching rules
scenarios.notes: Good news: the base URL is read in exactly one place (pokeapi.ts:1) and all URL building goes through apiUrl/mediaUrl/spriteUrl. Bad news: 'caching' is two layers — getJson's promise cache (pokeapi.ts:28) plus seven hand-rolled memoized singletons in data.ts:23-30, each with its own catch-and-reset boilerplate — so adding TTLs or invalidation means rewriting eight sites unless a memoize() helper is introduced first.
